resources.string: SereinGram is an unofficial Telegram client based on Nagram. It is not affiliated with Telegram, Nagram, NagramX, NagramXF or AyuGram.
The Premium section holds Telegram Premium, Stars, TON, Business and gifts; the Help section holds questions, the FAQ, features and the privacy policy.
Hide the share button beside messages
Messages forwarded to Saved Messages keep the button, which opens the chat they came from.

Copies are kept for this account in a SereinGram database on this device, apart from Telegram\'s cache, so clearing the cache keeps them. Kept deleted messages come back into their chats marked as deleted. Only messages this device has loaded can be kept. Photos and files of deleted messages stay in Telegram\'s cache, so they show for as long as the cache keeps them.

Photos and files of up to 64 MB from deleted messages are copied into SereinGram\'s own storage, so they still show after Telegram\'s cache is cleared. Only media this device has downloaded can be copied.
Stands before the time of a kept deleted message. Leave it empty for the default; an emoji such as 🗑 works too.
No deleted messages of this chat were kept.
Each message shows when it was deleted. Tap one to find it in the chat.
The deleted messages kept of this chat are removed from SereinGram for good. They leave the chat the next time it is opened.
No earlier versions of this message were kept.
Shows the full address and asks before a link opens in the browser. Links to Telegram itself still open directly.
Show a ghost beside the chat list title

Ghost mode keeps your read receipts, online status, typing and story views to yourself. While read receipts are held back, SereinGram also keeps back reading channel comments and secret chats, and the channel posts you look at are not counted as views.
Let this chat see what ghost mode keeps from everyone else.
These chats see your read receipts or typing although ghost mode keeps them from everyone else. Choose them in a chat\'s menu; long press a chat here to remove its exceptions.
No chat has exceptions yet. Choose them in a chat\'s menu, under ghost mode in this chat.
Add a toggle to the home screen
Ghost mode can also be switched from a tile in quick settings: edit the tiles in the notification shade and add SereinGram\'s ghost mode.
This home screen cannot add shortcuts.
Offers to block the sender in the menu of a message someone else sent in a group or in a channel\'s comments.
Show the date beside the time
Messages from before today show their day and month next to the time, or the full date when they are from an earlier year.
Searching from the chat list no longer lists public people, groups and channels you are not in; your chats, contacts and messages are still found. Applies the next time SereinGram starts.
Text pasted into messages and captions loses the bold, links, tables and other formatting it was copied with. Needs Android 6.0 or later.
While a passcode locks SereinGram, notifications only say that a message arrived. With this on they show who wrote and what, as when the app is unlocked. Secret chats stay hidden.
Bookmark messages from their menu to come back to them later. A chat with bookmarks lists them in its own menu.
No bookmarks yet. Bookmark a message from its menu.
Tap a bookmark to go to its message; long press it to remove it.
Give people, groups and channels names that only this device shows, from the menu of their chat.
Tap a name to open its chat; long press it to go back to the name Telegram gives.
Shown only on this device, instead of the name Telegram gives.
The search from the chat list no longer has a tab of mini apps and bots. Applies the next time SereinGram starts.
Messages you send keep a single check after they were read, in chats and in the chat list, so you do not see when they were read. Telegram still knows.

Sending a message shows you online even in ghost mode. With this on, while ghost mode hides your online status, messages you send wait a few seconds as scheduled messages and appear in the chat once they go out. Secret chats are left as they are.
In the menu of a group or channel
Each screen shows up only where you may open it, for example recent actions and permissions for admins.
